subject: Discovery recap — request for sizing playbook slot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finito.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — request for sizing playbook slot

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — really helpful to understand Finito's high-level goals for invoice automation and the load shape you're expecting. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary workload: invoice parsing + contextual generation for exception handling.
- Expected peak: ~120 qps across spikes (burst ~220 qps for ~2–5m windows).
- Target P95 latency: <= 220ms for 512-token responses; average seq length ~420 tokens.
- Sensitive data: customer PII will be sent but Finito requires strict separation and audit logs.

Next step we discussed: a dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive) to validate throughput/latency targets and map to Dedicated pool sizing + routing policy. Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) Confirm traffic profile & sample prompts (you send sample payloads)
2) Expected SLAs and fallback tolerances
3) Candidate model families & quantization trade-offs
4) Benchmarks & data collection plan (what logs we need)
5) Timeline and any compliance prerequisites

I attached a short PDF of notes from today's call and a draft sizing agenda. Can you share two 45-minute windows next week that work for your infra/tech lead? For convenience here's a booking link: https://cal.example.com/karthik/slot

Also flagged in advance: if you can share a 24–48h sample of anonymized request logs (qps by minute, seq lengths, common prompts) it will make the sizing call much more productive — a Drive link or S3 path is fine.

Thanks — I'll loop in Marissa from CS so we can cover rollout and handoff items in the same session.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finito.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — request for sizing playbook slot

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear recap.

Priya Shah (our platform lead) should join the sizing call — looping her in below. A couple quick questions before we lock a slot:

1) Can Redwood provide a short example SLA and an order-of-magnitude cost estimate for the Dedicated pool options (we're evaluating monthly committed vs burst)?
2) On logs: we can export 48h of anonymized request-level metrics (qps, latencies, token counts) but need to know the exact fields you want in the CSV.

We're available: Mon 17 May 10:30–11:15 EDT or Tue 18 May 14:00–14:45 EDT. Either works for Priya and me; we prefer the later slot on Tue if it fits your team's calendar.

Thanks —
Sam Turner
Head of Product | Finito Payments
sam.turner@finito.com

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — request for sizing playbook slot

Hi Sam / Priya —

Tue 18 May 14:00–14:45 EDT works for us; I booked the slot on our shared calendar and sent a calendar invite (please accept when you can). Confirmed attendees from Redwood: me, Marissa (Customer Success), and Grace (Solutions Architect).

To answer your items:
- SLA example: attached is a short one-pager showing 99/95/90 latency bands and availability targets we usually map to Dedicated; it's intentionally high-level so you can share with procurement.
- Cost estimate: attached XLS contains a ballpark monthly committed vs burst projection based on the peak qps you mentioned in the call — treat it as an initial model, we'll refine after we see real logs.
- Log fields we need (CSV): timestamp (UTC), request_id, token_in, token_out, seq_length, latency_ms, model_hint (if available), and a redaction flag for PII. A Drive link to a zipped CSV is perfect.

Agenda for the call (attached as docx):
1) Quick intro & goals (5m)
2) Walk through sample logs & traffic patterns (10–15m)
3) Mapping to Dedicated pool config, batching & cache expectations (10m)
4) Next steps: bench plan + action items (5–10m)

Attachments: sizing-agenda.docx, redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx, redwood-sla-onepager.pdf

If legal needs an NDA or an MSA draft ahead of the session, loop in your legal contact and we'll share our standard MSA template; otherwise we can proceed with the technical deep dive.

See you on Tue — thanks for the quick turnaround.

—
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (Excel, 24 KB)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finito.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finito.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — request for sizing playbook slot

Confirmed — thanks Karthik, Marissa, Grace. I've accepted the calendar invite and shared a Drive folder with anonymized 48h traffic: https://drive.google.com/finito/sample-traffic-logs. The CSV includes the fields you requested and a README with a schema.

One ask for the call: could Redwood include a quick example of how automatic prefix/KV caching would change throughput estimates for the most common prompt? We have several templates that hit the same prompt pattern frequently. If you can include a short slide or note on that, it would help the procurement conversation.

Looking forward to the session on Tue.

—
Priya Shah
Platform Lead | Finito Payments
